description: Add recipients to a message that was already sent (one you sent or received as a primary recipient). They receive the message and its attachments, can read it and become participants of its thread. This cannot be undone. Fails on terminal messages.

add_to.description: deprecated alias of recipients; pass one or the other

id.description: the sent message to add recipients to

recipients.description: addresses or short names to add

name: add_recipients

recipients.description: the resolved addresses that were added

resolved.description: short names and how they resolved, when any were given; confirm with the user if an address looks wrong

title: Add fmsg recipients
